## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 7/10** · likely safe to merge Metering share composition is sound for logs and traces, but the metrics item count is off by unit and the TTL knob is unreachable in prd. 2 warnings −2 · 1 note · tests partial −1 · risk medium · 4/4 new units observable Applies per-org drop/redact rules at the top of `process_decoded_payload`, behind `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED`, and scales metering on every path by what the rules left. Sound with the feature off; two metering/config defects need fixing before it is turned on. - `apply_ingest_rules` redacts and drops before the native/forward split - `Retained` composes paused-source and rule shares, capped at 1 - `IngestRuleResolver` caches compiled rules per org with last-known-good fallback - `IngestRuleStatsSink` batches per-rule counts into `org_ingest_rule_stats` every 60s ### Before merge - [ ] **Env var** · Set `INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS` in every environment, or confirm its default · [`apps/ingest/src/main.rs:594`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/5c3a25eb6d43abb18ab25f9aa5e71907cbce7c59/apps/ingest/src/main.rs#L594) - [ ] **Env var** · Add `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED=true` to the ingest task env in `apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts` / Infisical when the feature should go live · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts:651`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/5c3a25eb6d43abb18ab25f9aa5e71907cbce7c59/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts#L651) ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · metered_items subtracts data-point drops from a metric count correctness · [`apps/ingest/src/main.rs:6852-6854`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/5c3a25eb6d43abb18ab25f9aa5e71907cbce7c59/apps/ingest/src/main.rs#L6852-L6854) `dropped_items` comes from `stats.total.dropped`, which `apply_metrics` increments per dropped *data point*, while `metered_items` is fed `DecodedPayload::item_count()`, which counts metric streams (`count_metric_items`). A metrics batch that loses one metric's points therefore reports 0 metered items, and in `store_delivery` the `stored > 0 && metered_bytes > 0` gate (main.rs:6319) then records no usage and makes no Autumn call at all for bytes that were stored and shipped. ``` Set `dropped_items` from the payload's own item count (`decoded.item_count()` before and after the rules) instead of `stats.total.dropped`, which counts data points for metrics. ```
🟠 Warning · F2 · INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS never reaches the deployed task correctness · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts:650-651`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/5c3a25eb6d43abb18ab25f9aa5e71907cbce7c59/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts#L650-L651) `AppConfig` reads `INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS` (main.rs:592), but only `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED` was added to the task `env`, so the TTL setting is dropped and every deployment runs the 30s default no matter what is set in the environment. Every other `INGEST_*` tuning variable in this block is passed through the same way. ``` // Customer ingest rules (docs/ingest-rules.md); off unless set to "true". ...(yield* optionalPlain("INGEST_RULES_ENABLED")), ...(yield* optionalPlain("INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS")), ```
🔵 Note · F3 · Flush retry and give-up accounting has no test tests · [`apps/ingest/src/rules_gateway.rs:204-233`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/5c3a25eb6d43abb18ab25f9aa5e71907cbce7c59/apps/ingest/src/rules_gateway.rs#L204-L233) The new counting rules in `flush` — a failed chunk is restored and re-sent, the rest of the batch is skipped after one failure, and the counts are dropped after `MAX_FAILED_FLUSHES` — are the part where a mistake loses per-rule stats silently, and the handler tests only cover a clean flush. The repository tests this kind of accumulator behaviour elsewhere (e.g. the Autumn flusher in `apps/ingest/src/autumn.rs`), and the fake store already exists. ``` Add a `FakeKeyStore` case that fails `record_ingest_rule_stats` and asserts the counts come back on the next successful flush, and that the 10th consecutive failure drops them and bumps `ingest_rule_stats_dropped_total`. ```
### Production impact
Telemetry this change adds and removes (2) - ➕ attribute `enduser.email` · `apps/ingest/src/ingest_rules.rs:1832` - ➕ attribute `http.server.duration` · `apps/ingest/src/ingest_rules.rs:1835`
What was checked - With the feature off, `retained.share` stays `None`, so Cloudflare, GCP, AWS and gRPC meter exactly what they did before - Empty scopes and resources are pruned by `apply_traces`/`apply_logs`/`apply_metrics`, so a fully dropped payload has `encoded_len() == 0` and meters nothing - `org_ingest_rule_stats` has the `(org_id, rule_id, bucket, signal)` primary key the upsert's `ON CONFLICT` needs (`drizzle/20261028000546_ingest_rule_stats/migration.sql:11`)

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
The billing share is now a capped product of a recount, not a subtraction, and each OTLP path is pinned by a handler test; only the flush retry accounting is still untested.
<sub>1 note · tests covered · risk high −1 · 5/5 new units observable</sub>

Runs customer ingest rules in the gateway before the WAL and meters only the retained share on every OTLP path, including Cloudflare, GCP and AWS. Behaviour is behind `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED` (on for PR previews only), and the two earlier defects are fixed.

- `apply_ingest_rules` drops and redacts at the top of `process_decoded_payload`, before native/forward split
- `Retained` composes paused-source and rule shares; a fully dropped payload meters nothing and skips Autumn
- `rules_gateway` caches compiled rules per org with last-known-good on store failure
- Per-rule counters flush into `org_ingest_rule_stats` every 60s with retry and give-up

inline.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **`metered_items` subtracts data-point drops from a metric count**
>
> <sub>F1 · Warning · correctness</sub>

`dropped_items` comes from `stats.total.dropped`, which `apply_metrics` increments per dropped *data point*, while `metered_items` is fed `DecodedPayload::item_count()`, which counts metric streams (`count_metric_items`). A metrics batch that loses one metric's points therefore reports 0 metered items, and in `store_delivery` the `stored > 0 && metered_bytes > 0` gate (main.rs:6319) then records no usage and makes no Autumn call at all for bytes that were stored and shipped.

```
Set `dropped_items` from the payload's own item count (`decoded.item_count()` before and after the rules) instead of `stats.total.dropped`, which counts data points for metrics.
```

> [!WARNING]
> **`INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS` never reaches the deployed task**
>
> <sub>F2 · Warning · correctness</sub>

`AppConfig` reads `INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS` (main.rs:592), but only `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED` was added to the task `env`, so the TTL setting is dropped and every deployment runs the 30s default no matter what is set in the environment. Every other `INGEST_*` tuning variable in this block is passed through the same way.

```suggestion
				// Customer ingest rules (docs/ingest-rules.md); off unless set to "true".
				...(yield* optionalPlain("INGEST_RULES_ENABLED")),
				...(yield* optionalPlain("INGEST_RULES_CACHE_TTL_SECS")),
```
